[2026-08-30T08:22:12.855Z] [player] Ask why the stall is here
[2026-08-30T08:22:12.857Z] [world] "Stall goes up where the ground is flat and comes down when it is not worth it," the trader says. "That is the whole business plan."

[2026-08-30T08:22:14.238Z] [player] Ask how far they range
[2026-08-30T08:22:14.239Z] [world] "I do this stretch and one other." They gesture vaguely. "Any more and you are travelling, not trading. Travelling is how you lose stock."
[2026-08-30T08:22:14.240Z] [world] Riska Panhandle talks to you while doing something else, which is its own kind of trust.
[2026-08-30T08:22:14.409Z] [debug] persist sizes(KB): total=156 player=28 wm=44[rooms=15 events=1 memos=0 npcs=1 defeated=0 tags=0 discovered=0] log=82 scene=3
[2026-08-30T08:22:15.289Z] [player] Ask why they trade out here
[2026-08-30T08:22:15.291Z] [world] "Because out here I am the only shop in the world." The trader grins at their own arithmetic. "In a settlement I am one stall among twenty. On this stretch of road I am civilization ITSELF for half a day's walk in both directions. The mark-up is not greed, it is geography." The grin softens a notch. "Also — and do not spread this — somebody should be out here. Th
e road is long. A fire and a fair-enough price change what the road IS."
[2026-08-30T08:22:15.293Z] [world] Riska Panhandle keeps facing the way they were going, and talks to you sideways.
[2026-08-30T08:22:21.564Z] [world] You let the conversation go and Riska Panhandle gets back to it.
